item.description: - Plan limits on the Usage tab and the History page now count down with the clock. Before, a limit whose reading stayed at the same percent for hours kept showing an old "resets in" time and pace line until its reading changed. Thanks to Sally Hong for the detailed report.

- A new keyboard shortcut jumps to the agent that needs you: it brings forward the app of the session that has waited longest for you, or, if none is waiting, the one that finished last. Set it in Settings → General (there's none until you pick one). Tools switched off in Show in Dashbar are skipped. - Settings → About has Copy Diagnostics: a short summary for a bug report (Dashbar's and macOS's versions, which tools and integrations Dashbar found, any format warnings, the widgets' state, how many extra accounts and where Claude's plan limits come from). It never includes project names, folders, sessions or account names, Show Diagnostics lets you read it before you copy, and nothing is sent.

- On a Mac with a touch display (the MacBook Pro with a Dynamic Island), Dashbar's island now starts off for new installs, so it stays out of the way of the Dynamic Island. Settings → Notifications says why, and you can turn it on anyway. A choice you've already made is kept. - On a touch display, the panel shows the open and stop buttons on servers and the Trash button on clean-up folders without waiting for a hover, and its small buttons are easier to tap. Nothing changes on other Macs. - New desktop widgets: small ones for Codex's and Antigravity's plan limits, OpenCode's and GitHub Copilot's tokens today, and a medium "Tokens today" with each tool's tokens and estimated cost. Add them from the widget gallery. - A tool switched off in Show in Dashbar is left out of every widget, and its own widget says it's switched off instead of going blank.
